games.title: Hangman Hologram
games.description: Guess the hidden word one letter at a time before the energy meter empties.

games.title: Word Search Nebula
games.description: Find the target words hidden horizontally, vertically, or diagonally in the letter grid.

games.title: Anagram Reactor
games.description: Rearrange the scrambled letters into the correct word.

games.title: Word Ladder Lab
games.description: Change one letter at a time to transform COLD into WARM using valid four-letter words.

games.title: Cipher Vault
games.description: Crack the hidden four-colour code. Feedback shows correct colour in the right place and correct colour elsewhere.

games.title: Lights Out Matrix
games.description: Tap a tile to toggle it and its neighbours. Turn every light off.

games.title: Hanoi Neon Towers
games.description: Move all rings from the first peg to the third. Never place a larger ring on a smaller one.

games.title: Peg Solitaire Star
games.description: Jump pegs over neighbouring pegs into empty holes to remove the jumped peg. Finish with one peg.

games.title: Nimfire
games.description: Take 1–3 crystals from the pile. Whoever takes the last crystal wins.

games.title: Matchstick Equation
games.description: Move exactly one matchstick to make the displayed equation correct.

games.title: River Crossing Crew
games.description: Transport the fox, chicken, and grain across the river. The boat carries you plus one item; fox and chicken or chicken and grain cannot be left alone.

games.title: Water Sort Lab
games.description: Pour the top colour between tubes. Sort each tube into a single colour.

games.title: Pipeworks Circuit
games.description: Rotate pipe tiles to connect the source to the destination.

games.title: Laser Labyrinth
games.description: Rotate mirrors to guide the laser from emitter to receiver.

games.title: Tangram Orbit
games.description: Build a target silhouette by choosing and rotating geometric pieces.

games.title: Chromatic Alchemist
games.description: Mix primary colours to create the requested colour.

games.title: Orbit Pattern Logic
games.description: Choose the missing symbol in the evolving pattern.

games.title: Balance Bot
games.description: Balance the scale by selecting weights that match the target mass.

games.title: Higher or Lower Galaxy
games.description: Predict whether the next card will be higher or lower than the current card.

games.title: Blackjack Neon Table
games.description: Get as close to 21 as possible without busting. Dealer stands on 17.

games.title: Dice Forge Five
games.description: Roll five dice up to three times. Lock dice you want to keep; aim for five of a kind.

games.title: War of the Decks
games.description: Flip one card each round. Highest card wins the round; collect the most wins in ten rounds.

games.title: Spelling Bee Beacon
games.description: Listen to the clue and spell the word correctly.

games.title: Rhyme Time Arena
games.description: Choose the word that rhymes with the prompt.

games.title: Cosmic Quiz Show
games.description: Answer quick space and science trivia to build your score.

games.title: Mole Patrol
games.description: Tap the glowing mole before it disappears. Earn points in 20 seconds.

games.title: Bubble Pop Geometry
games.description: Aim a bubble into a matching cluster to pop groups of three or more.

games.title: Pinball Prism
games.description: Launch a pinball and tap the flippers to keep it bouncing through bumpers.

games.title: Mini Golf Comet
games.description: Put the ball into the hole with a single shot. Choose power and direction.

games.title: Slalom Sprint
games.description: Steer left and right to pass through gates without hitting flags.

games.title: Traffic Threader
games.description: Switch lanes to avoid traffic for as long as possible.

games.title: Cave Copter
games.description: Hold to rise and release to fall. Fly through the cave without touching its walls.

games.title: Submarine Sonar
games.description: Use sonar pings to locate the hidden submarine. Guess its grid coordinate in as few pings as possible.

games.title: Deep Sea Catch
games.description: Tap when the bobber plunges to catch a fish; early or late taps miss.

games.title: Target Toss
games.description: Throw a ball with a chosen angle and power to land inside the target ring.

games.title: Artillery Angle
games.description: Set elevation and charge to hit the distant bunker. Wind changes each shot.

games.title: Shadow Sneak
games.description: Reach the exit without stepping into a guard’s line of sight.

games.title: Micro Tower Defense
games.description: Place turrets along the path and stop waves of creeps reaching the base.

games.title: Pocket Farm Manager
games.description: Plant seeds, harvest crops, and earn coins to expand your tiny farm.

games.title: Crystal Miner
games.description: Mine blocks to uncover crystals. Pick the block with the strongest shimmer clue.

games.title: Factory Flow
games.description: Rotate conveyor arrows so parts travel from the source to the assembly station.

games.title: Train Dispatcher
games.description: Switch track junctions to guide each train to the matching-colour station.

games.title: Runway Control
games.description: Assign incoming planes to clear runways without sending two planes to the same strip.

games.title: Ecosystem Balance
games.description: Adjust plant, herbivore, and predator populations to keep the ecosystem balanced for five seasons.

games.title: Ant Colony Architect
games.description: Place food sources and guide ants along the shortest route back to the nest.

games.title: Quantum Clicker
games.description: Generate energy, buy multipliers, and reach one million energy.

games.title: Arcade Shopkeeper
games.description: Buy stock, set a price, and sell items to satisfy customers while earning profit.

games.title: Dungeon Tactics
games.description: Defeat a guard by choosing attack, defend, or potion at the right moment.

games.title: Grid Command Tactics
games.description: Move your unit to capture the control point while avoiding enemy zones.

games.title: Rogue Room Run
games.description: Explore a tiny dungeon, collect a key, and reach the exit while avoiding traps.

games.title: Lockpick Resonance
games.description: Tune three tumblers to the correct numbers using warm/cold feedback.

games.title: Safecracker Dial
games.description: Stop the rotating dial in the three target zones to open the safe.

games.title: Conductor’s Baton
games.description: Conduct a four-beat pattern by tapping the correct beat buttons in order.

games.title: Drum Fill Duel
games.description: Match the drummer’s requested rhythm by choosing kick, snare, and cymbal hits.

games.title: Type Racer Sprint
games.description: Type the sentence accurately before the timer runs out.

games.title: Reflex Reactor
games.description: Tap only when the signal turns green. False starts cost a life.

games.title: Pixel Aim Trainer
games.description: Hit the moving targets before they vanish.

games.title: Shape Rotation Lab
games.description: Rotate the shape to match the target orientation.

games.title: Gravity Flip Runner
games.description: Switch gravity to avoid spikes on both floor and ceiling.

games.title: Bridge Builder Mini
games.description: Place supports under the bridge to carry a moving truck across the gap.

games.title: Water Jug Riddle
games.description: Measure exactly four units using 3-unit and 5-unit jugs. Fill, empty, and pour between them.

games.title: Intersection Controller
games.description: Change traffic lights to prevent collisions while letting cars cross.

games.title: Paper Plane Navigator
games.description: Adjust pitch to glide through rings while managing altitude and speed.

games.title: Constellation Connect
games.description: Connect the stars in the requested order without lifting your finger.

games.title: Orbit Stabilizer
games.description: Adjust orbital speed to keep a satellite inside a stable band for ten ticks.

games.title: Cargo Bay Tetris
games.description: Load cargo crates into a ship with limited capacity without exceeding the weight limit.

games.title: Timeblock Tactician
games.description: Fit tasks into a six-slot schedule without overlaps; each task has a time window.

note: 100 unique games = 31 Part 1 standalone games + 2 preserved originals (Pac-Man and Candy Cascade) + 67 new Part 3 games. Part 2 pages remain archived but are excluded from the unique-game count because their core mechanics repeat Part 1.
